comment: Operations Chatwoot v4.19.1 serves but its published spec omits. Each is written from the source at the tag: config/routes.rb (resources :conversations, only: [..., :destroy]) and app/controllers/api/v1/accounts/conversations_controller.rb#destroy (authorize :destroy?, which app/policies/conversation_policy.rb allows for administrators only; head :ok).

corrections.comment: app/models/conversation.rb at v4.19.1: enum status: { open: 0, resolved: 1, pending: 2, snoozed: 3 }. The spec omits snoozed, which would make a snoozed conversation unreadable.
